item.title: [UGLY] Islami Bank Faces Liquidity Crisis, Receives Central Bank Support, Directors Removed
item.description:
Category: Ugly

Islami Bank Bangladesh Limited has faced a severe liquidity crisis, necessitating a significant special liquidity support of Tk 2,500 crore from Bangladesh Bank. Furthermore, all directors of the bank have been removed, indicating major governance failures and regulatory intervention to protect depositors' interests.

Why this matters: A major bank requiring emergency liquidity support and facing a complete board overhaul signals severe financial distress and governance failures.
